result.detail: Design choices: the clock period is 100 ns, so the per-step read sweeps and directed reads (1 ns apart) finish well before the next falling edge, where the next stimulus is driven. No cycle is left unmodelled. The reference model gets the same stimulus as each DUT and is compared after every edge. The directed checks also use hand-computed constants, so a bug shared by the model and the RTL would still be caught. Mutants these checks should catch: reversed priority (T5), a clear that wins over a detection (T7), swapped edge and level modes (T6), an ack range check on the wrong bits (T5, T9), and missing upper-bit masking (T2, T9). If the nonce plusarg name is not one of the four tried, the platform owner should supply it; the fix is a one-line edit in the testbench.
